title: A place you have travelled to that you would recommend
titleVi: Nơi bạn từng đến và muốn giới thiệu
prompt: Describe a place you have travelled to that you would like to recommend to others
bullets: what you saw and did there
and explain why you would like to recommend it to others

notes.label: Saw
notes.text: limestone mountains, rivers, caves, rice fields

notes.text: rowing boat through caves; 500 steps to Hang Múa; Hoa Lư

notes.label: Why recommend
notes.text: nature + history, close, affordable; go early, late May

part2.question: Describe a place you have travelled to that you would like to recommend to others

segments.v: I want to talk about Tràng An in Ninh Bình. I went there with my family last year. It is about two hours from Hà Nội by car. It has beautiful mountains, rivers and rice fields. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. We took a boat trip on the river. A local woman rowed the boat. We went through many caves. It was very quiet and beautiful. After that, we climbed up many steps to Hang Múa. It was very hot and tiring but the view was amazing. I want to recommend it because it is beautiful, near Hà Nội and not expensive. There is nature and history there. I think people should go there early in the morning to avoid crowds.
